notes.title: Survive the Outbreak – Plague: London 1665 is Now Available!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The wait is over! Step into the grim and perilous world of [b]Plague: London 1665[/b], now officially released on Steam, Epic and GoG!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

Set during the devastating Bubonic Plague outbreak in 1665, this pixel art RPG plunges you into the heart of overcrowded and disease-ridden London. As a body collector, graveyard keeper, and family provider, your survival depends on your ability to navigate these treacherous streets.

[h3]🎮 Get Plague: London 1665 now and face the outbreak head-on![/h3]

Will you risk it all to keep the city clean and your family fed, or will you become another victim of the deadly plague?

[h3]Collect bodies from the river and streets:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/f6d0e2ecf77e545fdbda4175c452cf07c20cdd02.gif[/img]

[h3]Transport them:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/e6620042ebf8ae90bba60248681e03bf4d3d9f9d.gif[/img]

[h3]Bury them:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/d6c6eed1e2f8e5274b740a2d22a5f7a4c94f5a4b.gif[/img]

In Plague: London 1665, every choice matters:

[list]
[*] Collect and Bury: Brave the streets as you collect the bodies of the deceased and give them a proper burial while avoiding infection.
[*] Scavenge and Trade: Resources are scarce. Find ways to gather supplies and barter with other survivors in this unforgiving environment.
[*] Meet NPCs: Engage with a diverse cast of characters, each with their own stories and agendas, as you make critical decisions that will shape the outcome of the game.
[*] Survive: Balance the needs of the city, your family, and yourself in a world where every move could mean life or death.
[/list]

With its blend of historical accuracy and intense gameplay, Plague: London 1665 offers a unique and immersive experience of one of history’s darkest times. The city’s fate is in your hands – will you survive?

Don't forget to share your experiences with us and leave a review! Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to improve and expand the game. Stay tuned for upcoming updates and announcements.

May luck be on your side in the streets of London.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

notes.title: Unveiling New Realms and Resolving the Shadows of the Past
notes.content:
In this update, we've resolved a peculiar graphical anomaly that would, on rare occasions, cause certain characters' shadows to appear stretched and distorted when transitioning between outdoor and indoor environments. We understand that this could break the immersion and wanted to ensure a seamless visual experience for all players. With this issue fixed, you can now enjoy a consistently captivating journey through the magical realms of Rising Mist.

[h3]🌟 Explore a New Adventure:[/h3] As a special treat, we've enhanced the main menu. Look out for a new option that allows you to embark on a sneak peek of our upcoming project in development, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/]Plague: London 1665[/url]! . Step into the chilling streets of 17th-century London during the Great Plague. It's a chance to experience history like never before.

We're grateful for your continued support and feedback, which help shape the world of Rising Mist. Stay tuned for more exciting updates, and may your adventures within our games be legendary!

[b]Also note that Rising Mist is now available on the Epic Store.[/b]

[b][h2][h2]May the mists guide your path![/h2][/h2][/b]

Many thanks,
WASD Games

notes.title: Survive the Plague: London 1665 - Wishlist Now on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]Wishlist our new game[/h2]

Introducing "Plague: London 1665," an upcoming RPG pixel art game set during one of the most devastating pandemics in history. The game puts you in the shoes of a body collector and graveyard keeper, tasked with keeping the city of London clear of corpses and giving the deceased a proper burial.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

With the Bubonic Plague outbreak in full swing, resources are scarce and competition for them is fierce. You must balance the need to provide for your family with the risk of contracting the deadly disease. Navigate the treacherous streets of London, scavenging for resources and trading with other survivors, all while avoiding the disease that threatens to claim thousands of lives.

As you progress through the game, you'll encounter a variety of NPCs, each with their own story and agenda. Every decision you make will have a significant impact on the outcome of the game. Will you prioritize the well-being of the city, the needs of your family, or your own survival?

"Plague: London 1665" offers a unique and immersive experience of being a body collector during a time of crisis, with a focus on historical accuracy and intense gameplay. We invite you to visit our Steam page to wishlist the game and stay updated on its development. Get ready to risk your life to clear out the streets, all for a hefty paycheck and the well-being of the city.

notes.title: Items – Devlog #10
notes.content:
[h1]Items in Rising Mist[/h1]
For this devlog episode we have decided to dig into items that you can stumble upon in Occoterra, one way or another. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/b0c062ebf2ba61603aa9f212802f30383465fce5.jpg[/img]

As you might remember we talked about crafting in our Devlog #3 and how individual items can create a new item. As that Devlog was titled Crafting in naturally left out all of the items that are not generated with a crafting process and this is what we want to talk about today.

If you missed Devlog #3 here is the link:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1514610

In Rising Mist you can come by non-crafted items by just looking around and finding them in nature, lets say for example a Goblin Eye Flower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/8f9f89bc8dd9b05eaea51ca71734f25452c13430.jpg[/img]

Other then finding items you can also mine them for example different kinds of Ore and rare Gems.
Then if you need wood you can go to the Logging Camp chop down a few tree, get logs from it and process them into wood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/c340d30cf6dc350e62823bc0a88fb82059a7910d.jpg[/img]

Other more important items are food in particular fish. On different fishing spots located near Lakes and river, you can turn to fishing and hope to catch a few fish.
You might get lucky and even catch some unique ones...

notes.title: Roadmap and relevant dates
notes.content:
[h1][b]Roadmap and relevant dates[/b][/h1]

For this Steam post we decided to talk about the current state of Rising Mist. 
What is done what still needs to be developed, where are we test wise and try to work out a very rough date for the release of Rising Mist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/508e70a667ba36f1d2a2e3f304dd347c66484ba5.jpg[/img]

We have been working on this game for a bit over a year now and everything is coming along nicely development wise. So we don’t expect any major hiccups (hopefully this will not jinx it). ːsteamhappyː
Roughly speaking about 80-85% of the games mechanics are done, implemented and tested internally.
Also about 70-75% of the story and events surrounding it are currently implemented and working.
We are generally satisfied with the progress that we made and are confident that we will be able to determine a exact release date in the next 30-60 days.

While the game is mostly done, we don’t want to rush it as we want to invest as much time as needed into testing the game before determining a release date. As our primary goal is to have a decent and bug-free version on the release date, all planned features included.

Currently we are working on populating Occoterra, finishing up designs for Steam Achievements and adjusting the Save and Load system. Populating Occoterra and finishing the Steam Achievement designs will probably be completed by the end of next week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/30925d6a277bb41118f0813633d7a314b6d3e8a2.jpg[/img]

As you can see from this post we are unable to determine a 100% release date right now, but a very unofficial date that we are working towards is November 2021 but depends on the end user testing that we plan to host before announcing the release date. So if we would not be satisfied with the results from that test event we would in that case release the game in February 2022. Generally speaking these are the 2 date we are working towards so not very far away. :)

Hopefully you are looking forward to the release date.
If so please hit the Wishlist button to stay update on further news about Rising Mist.

[b]Add to your wishlist on Steam:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif[/img]

Thank you for reading.

notes.title: Combat – Devlog #8
notes.content:
[h1]Combat in Rising Mist[/h1]
Today we want to talk about the combat mechanics in Rising Mist.
Below you can find a short video of how the corrent battle mechanics looks like. In this particular video the player is casting a spell on his opponent and therefore disabling has ability to react and after that we launches and lands a attack.

[previewyoutube=ZJUw4ukA4hk;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Note, this is a video from the work environment and is not the final result.[/i]

Battles in Rising Mist are very common as bandits wait patiently for you to cross their path and other creatures just lurk in the shadows and prepare for your arrival. 
Therefore it is alway wise to have a few Health Potions, some Stunny Mist Potions and even maybe a Anti Magic Elixir in your pocket, this way you are able to have a advantage over your opponent yet that does not mean you will automatically defeat your opponent.

Key elements to succeeding in combat are your weapons, swords for attack and shields for defense. A important role plays also your experience level. If you are for example equipped with a very strong sword and a very strong shield but your experience level is low, while your opponents attack and defense gear is low but his experience level is high, you would have a hard time defeating such an opponent even with potions. It's not impossible but it is difficult.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/30925d6a277bb41118f0813633d7a314b6d3e8a2.jpg[/img]

While journeying through Occoterra you will slowly but steadily encounter more and more powefull opponents so take every opportunity to train your skills, improve your experiance and do not pass on a good sword or sheild offer.

Keep in mind Occoterra is lawless and if bandits defeat you in battle, they will surely not pass the opportunity to robb you as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif[/img]

We will keep you updated! :)

notes.title: Travel Permits – Devlog #7
notes.content:
What are travel permits, where do you obtain them and what purpose do they serve.
In this post we want to give you a brief overview about travel permits and their importance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/c6710b843edb4c779a7de7c25d66f3635bcb045a.jpg[/img]

Occoterra is divided as never before, ever since the great war the inheritance of Occoterra need special travel permits in order to travel and enter Cities. Anyone without a travel permit it denied entrance to almost any City. This also means that travel permits are valuable and counterfeit them would be a lucrative business for anyone.

You can obtain travel permits on many different way’s but most common is by just helping out people in the cities and they might gift you a travel permit as they are transferable.
But be aware on your travels, bandits are lurking on every corner and if you are not careful or strong enough they just might steal one from you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/b975af6d494bb36f6ee4c4e76793c1da6b1c8636.jpg[/img]

Without travel permits your quests and journeys are limited only to the cities for which you already have travel permits in you possession, so make sure you complete every mission, every task and look under every rock to obtain one.

[b]Add to your wishlist on Steam:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif[/img]

We will keep you updated! :)
Thank you for reading.

notes.title: Alliances – Devlog #6
notes.content:
The focus of Rising Mist is in gathering allies for your cause. All will depend on the number of allies that you can persuade to follow you. This will determine your success in the last battle for Occoterra against tyranny of Toraya and Ragdrak.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/48cea8049b2f933b9d8585ce5a7e0c988dcf4216.jpg[/img]

You will notice that allies can be found among different social layers in almost all cities of Occoterra male and female. For instance (renegades, craftsman, solders, etc…) who already have a certain number of their own followers. Once you successfully form an alliance with someone you will be able to also count on the support of their followers as well. For example, one of your first allies will definitely be a craftsman who is a leader of a small group of likeminded rebels following him, yet still he will prove to be very valuable due to his connections in Occoterra.

For individual rebel leaders to join your cause they will first need to trust you. You also need to present yourself to them as a useful and strong ally for them. It is therefore crucial that you develop all sorts of different skills including combat. Your skills will determine if a potential ally will offer you his alliance. They will also ask of you to complete certain tasks like gathering food for them or anything else they might need at that moment or overcoming different obstacles between geostrategic points (let it be a demolished bridge or living obstacles like dragons, trolls, bandits, etc…). Your allies can help you in difficult times with informations, hints, they enable you to progress in the game when you get stuck. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/cf7640679ba050705de464967950485f61a7d2c7.jpg[/img]

Every allay represents a small fraction of the main story. So, every time you successfully add an ally to your cause, a part of the hidden past gets revealed and gradually your path and fate will become clearer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif[/img]

We will keep you updated! :)
Thank you for reading.

notes.title: Potions – Devlog #5
notes.content:
[b]We have released the announcement trailer! We will be happy to hear what you think about it. 
Do you like it? Are you excited like we are? 
Let us know.[/b]
[previewyoutube=_SJuZajtTs4;full][/previewyoutube]
Today we want to go through the mechanics of potion making. Potions slowly revel the magical and mystic side of Rising Mist. Ultimately potions will be essential to progress the story and more, so they are a key element when it comes to battles.

You can get several different potions from Olida. She is a nice old lady, a herbalist, who can help you with potions, amulets etc. Potion brewing is her main source of income, so she will ask you for a small fee before starting to brew a potion.

To brew any kind of potions, you will first need a recipe for it. Recipes can just wait for you to get picked up in plain sight, but it takes much more effort to find the most important ones, therefore it is good to listen to the people you are encounter on your adventure. When you learn the ingredients for a individual potion you will need to gather them. Some ingredients you can grow on your fields, others you can find growing in forests and meadows, some you will even find in the darkest of places. To brew a potion you will need Olida’s services, but do not take her help for granted. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/508e70a667ba36f1d2a2e3f304dd347c66484ba5.jpg[/img]

You need to wait a few days or in some cases even weeks until the potion is finished, depending on the complexity of the potions itself. Once you pick up the crafted potion you can immediately use it. With potions you can restore your health, cast spells upon your enemies and foe’s, put dragons to slumber etc. You can also sell them for a nice profit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/c7536b245e1afe2d05919a510b61c27b79441219.png[/img]

notes.title: Farming – Devlog #4
notes.content:
In the last devlog #3 we were exploring the crafting mechanics that Rising Mist offers. For today we decided to get into farming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/482d6325e2331db474a98686afa8d42ce8942da8.jpg[/img]

At the beginning farming is one of the main sources of income in Rising Mist. When you start the game you have one field that you can farm. This also means in order to fund your adventure you will need to be returning to your fields or find other lucrative sources of income.
Once you have a sufficient amount of money you will be able to purchase additional fields which means you will be able to grow more corps and generate a lager profit.

As you start the game you have a basic farming skill but you can always upgrade your skills via the skills tree and a better farming skill means a better and more plentiful crops from each harvest.

In order to grow something on your fields you will need to find or buy seeds. Every seed takes a different amount of time to grow on your field and the crops that grow each have a different price value when trying to sell it raw. 
Exemple: Corn takes 33 days to grow and is not valuable but corn you can process to flour and increase your profit.  At the other hand from seeds to gown crops berries need 25 days but their value is much higher as the value of corn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/b53d8a72ad083d3778ee997bf1da63d8e2e28df6.jpg[/img]

Farming in Rising Mist is not just about profits, you can grow crops for purpose of processing it or for food. There are even some crops that you can grow that can be used to craft potions with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/94efd3c04008abd7fe8aba24722f8554ae0713ac.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Crafting – Devlog #3
notes.content:
In today’s devlog we would like to give you some insight to crafting and the importance of it in Rising Mist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/6d32f62e5b2c7671db44ec45b219a5cdf0bb8c37.jpg[/img]

The crafting is very much intertwined with every day things that you can do such as framing, woodcutting or mining for example. Once the player has started farming it will eventually result in a crop yield. The abundance of crops yield form a harvest is connected with luck. If the player is lucky his fields can produce a lot of crop at the same time if he is not the harvest can be dramatically reduced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/6c9c6248a8c59f8bd81fa2482924499affdb7eb9.jpg[/img]

Once the player collected the crop from his fields he can take it to be processed. Depending on what crop the player choose to plant. A raw product like corn can be processed to corn flour. While raw items such as corn are not valued as much as processed crop, therefore it only makes sense to process as much crops as possible to achieve the maximum profits of a harvest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/c65e5937110b4b77c1ceca2d68793ec93619f5ab.jpg[/img]

For some processed goods it is wise to have them in the pocket while other types of processed goods are needed for the journey ahead.

notes.title: Cities of Occoterra - Devlog #2
notes.content:
In this second devlog, we present the general concept and purpose of cities and some other places in the fantasy world of Occoterra.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/85835d3f1a556a39dcbced40fe71e557482a3e3c.jpg[/img]

In the role of a traveler, the player travels throughout Occoterra with the help of a map, on which the routes and cities are shown only when the hero completes the main tasks in each city, or when he obtains a travel permit for the city.

In the course of the story, there are 7 cities that are most important: from the small rural settlement of Stillshire, larger commercial, craft, seaside and island towns, to the mighty capital Tarrogar, which is under the influence of dark magic.

In addition to the cities, some symbolic places are more important to the story then other, such are the ancient ruins, fantasy forest and the dark Tartarus caves in the north west of Occoterra.

Each city has unique characteristics given to it by its inhabitants and the geographical location. In addition to the story, the characteristics of the city also influences the tasks that the traveler has to complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/563e9a798f98472082ee6fa3f3bf56bf8a41fa7f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: First steps - Devlog #1
notes.content:
This being the first devlog for Rising Mist we wanted you to get to know the idea, environment and the world, and also the current development state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/a3854b46e524a960318292e39b4e21a0430cb592.jpg[/img]

The key points of Rising Mist are traveling the world called Occoterra, resource management, completing tasks, helping locals, or gathering resources as you travel form city to city.

Rising Mist is a story driven point and click adventure so we are trying to make the story as much
interesting and mysterious as possible. 

Currently there are 11 major cities that the player can visit and at this point another 15 locations that can be visited (like fishing spots, etc.). Each city has it's own challenges, people, creatures and tasks that you need to overcome. 

The world map, UI, characters and items are already designed and ready to be implemented. An early traveling system is also developed yet will need to be tested and extended.
Some of the early dialog events are also implemented and are being tested currently. All in all, a lot still needs to be done but this is a project that excites us very much and we are devoting it many hours and energy.
